text:
Type: cable knit throw blanket
Use: warmth on a sofa, an armchair or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, farmhouse, traditional
Materials: chunky knitted cotton yarn, cable knit pattern, ribbed borders
Colors: warm beige, light sand
Shape: folded rectangular throw with raised cable braids across the surface, ribbed knitted edges, soft and thick, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, warm, soft, homey
Goes with: cream or grey sofas, light wood, wool and linen, warm neutrals; Scandinavian or farmhouse living rooms
